notes: «وجدته في كتاب كان كتبه أيوب بن موسى عن الزهري»: the report cites a book whose writer is Ayyub; the author of a cited book is for ruling (rule 11). Ayyub is written after Sufyan; the ruling decides whether the route runs through the book or through him
«أسأل الزهري» and «قلت لسفيان» are scene (rule 6), not links
